text.text: Pandit Sudhamay Chakraborty did our Griha Pravesh puja. He was very patient and knowledgeable. Having a smooth experience with bookmypuja.

We had booked Griha Pravesh Puja from BookMyPooja, it was a very easy and smooth process, complete online process with regular updates from Pandit Ji being assigned till the completion, proper details of each package was explained with proper bifurcation of what Pandit Ji will bring & what we need to arrange, Pandit Ji did very good Pooja with proper detailed explanation and complete rituals, it was a very divine experience and we felt very good with the way Pooja was done, thanks & Kudos to the BookMyPooja team..

We had a fabulous experience with Book my Pooja. It was hassle free and easy from start to finish. Narsimha was very informative and helped us choose a Pooja that we wanted. Additionally, the pandit came on time and with all the Pooja samagri. We were over all very happy with the entire experience.

We booked a Poojari through BookMyPooja for our House Warming ceremony, and were assigned Datta Guru garu. He conducted the pooja exceptionally well, impressing every guest with how beautifully a traditional Telugu House Warming can be performed in Bengaluru. I would highly recommend him.

Great service provided by the company for my new car pooja. Being new to Bangalore, I was unsure about getting pundit ji. After coming across bookmypooja, i was able to book pundit ji at my convenient time and place. Pooja was also done with all rituals

Organised a New Office Puja via BookMyPooja. It was on super short notice but they were very helpful and co-operative. They followed up on everything and offered a lot of assistance. The Pooja/Havan itself was very detailed and surpassed our expectations. The decorations (Alankar) was also very beautiful. Overall, a highly satisfactory experience.

I had a great experience with the service provided. I was so worried of how things will be managed but connecting with BookmyPooja helped me. The executive helped me arranging for the Pandit according to my requirements also managed the everything with regular follow up. I am very happy and would recommend this to my family and friends. The best part that i liked is the quick response and easy connect. Any query or doubts are cleared immediately. The Pandit assigned was so cooperative and conducted the pooja very well. He also explained the rituals followed and the kids of my family got to know more about it. Very Happy to say my overall experience was amazing. Thank you for making things so easy for us.
Neha Reddy.

I requested an e-pooja with Book my Pooja service. The response was very quick, efficient and empathetic, I also shared my budget limitations and they did their best to carry everything out with care and ease. I am very grateful for their patience and pooja arrangements. They made sure to engage dedicated panditjis and carried out the whole process smoothly and also made sure to record one part of pooja that I missed due to some wifi issues. I really appreciate their understanding and respect towards the sacred duty of pooja rituals and the emotions of the families who need to do the rituals, but cannot be there physically. Thank you Book my Pooja and to Narasimhan sir and his supportive staff. This pooja meant a lot to me, as it was for my dearest mom. I would recommend Book my Pooja to anyone I know, without hesitation.

We had a great experience with BookMyPooja team,
For preparations also the guidelines were very much clear. Very happy with the way the Pandit ji held the pooja. He was very clear and explained all the rituals well.
Over all a wonderful experience
